subject: FinWaves MAP: compliance runway and localized retention carveouts
messages:
From: Emma Laurent <emma.laurent@finwaves.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: security@finwaves.com
Date: 2028-04-10T09:18:00Z
Subject: MAP kickoff + retention carveouts (FinWaves)

Hi Markus + Kim,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is aligned and we want to get the MAP locked so procurement and legal can start parallel work. Two items we need clarified before we commit to the sprint:

- Localized retention: EU customers will require a 90-day customer-visible retention for PII in logs, with an option for 30-day short-term retention for non-billing telemetry. We also have one use case that needs a 540-day billing retention window. Can Redwood support per-account retention tiers and a carveout for billing?
- DPA redlines: attached is our latest redline (DPA_redline_v2.docx). We need a response on the main carveouts within 5 business days.

I attached a first pass MAP spreadsheet (FinWaves_MAP_v3.xlsx) and a draft SIG/CAIQ file with our initial questions. Please loop in security + solutions owners who will be needed for evidence.

Goal: align on MAP milestones and security gate acceptance so we can target an April close window if all goes well.

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Laurent
CISO, FinWaves
Emma.laurent@finwaves.com

Attachments: FinWaves_MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), SIG-CAIQ-responses-draft.pdf (pdf), DPA_redline_v2.docx (word)

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Emma Laurent <emma.laurent@finwaves.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-11T14:22:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + retention carveouts (FinWaves)

Hi Emma — appreciate the clear asks. I reviewed the attachments and sketched a proposed MAP and timeline below. Kim and I will shepherd legal/ops together. Erin (security) + Priyom (solutions) are on this thread for technical/evidence items.

High level MAP (proposed):
- Week 1 (Apr 11–18): Technical Q&A + SIG gaps, DPA redline feedback (we will return annotated DPA within 5 business days from receipt of redline)
- Week 2 (Apr 19–25): Evidence handoff (SOC 2 excerpts, encryption/KMS diagrams, EU data routing confirmation)
- Week 3 (Apr 26–28): Final signoff (DPA execution, attestation of retention config, go/no-go)

Security gates / acceptance criteria we recommend including in the MAP:
- SOC 2 Type II (recent report or SOC2 excerpt + control summary)
- Completed SIG/CAIQ responses covering data handling, key mgmt, and segmentation
- Executed DPA with agreed retention tiers and carveouts

Action items:
- Irene: can you confirm SOC 2 reporting date and whether we can provide an excerpt for evidence?
- Priyom: can you confirm whether per-account retention tiers and a specific billing retention path (540d) are supported today and how those are configured (console/API)?
- Kim: I'll coordinate with legal on the DPA turn-around and track signatures.

Emma — once we have those three confirmations we will lock the MAP and publish the task list in the spreadsheet you attached.

Markus
VP, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: FinWaves_MAP_v3.xlsx

From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-12T08:05:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + retention carveouts (FinWaves)

Markus — quick answers from security so we can lock the lane: 

- SOC 2: We have a Type II report for the period ending 2027-12-31. We can provide an unredacted SOC 2 report under NDA or a redacted excerpt (SOC2-excerpt.pdf) for platform-level controls immediately.
- SIG/CAIQ: Our security team maintains a living CAIQ; current coverage is ~95% of the control set. Outstanding items are primarily around customer-managed KMS workflows and third-party subprocessor attestations. I will attach a short control-gap table and ETA for completing the remaining CAIQ rows (target Apr 18).
- Retention & routing: Redwood supports policy-based retention tiers via account configuration. Current standard options are 30/90/365 days; we can enable a 540-day billing retention as a configured exception (requires an ops ticket and documented acceptance in the MAP). For EU residency: we can route logs to an EU-only storage cluster (requires a scoped migration window and acceptance of potential replication lag during the cutover).

Evidence I can provide now:
- SOC2-excerpt.pdf (controls summary)
- KMS-diagram.png (attachment stub)
- Retention-config-ops-note.txt (attachment stub)

Acceptance nuance: If FinWaves requires per-tenant physical separation (single-tenant storage), that would push the timeline and require a Dedicated/Private deployment; our per-account routing is logical isolation only. Please confirm which level you need.

Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-excerpt.pdf, KMS-diagram.png, Retention-config-ops-note.txt

From: Emma Laurent <emma.laurent@finwaves.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, procurement@finwaves.com
Date: 2028-04-14T10:12:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + retention carveouts (FinWaves)

Thanks — that helps a lot. A few clarifications before we finalize the MAP spreadsheet:

1) Billing retention: we will accept a configured exception (540d) provided we receive an ops runbook that documents how billing data is segregated and recovered in case of incident. Please add a milestone for "Billing retention runbook delivered".

2) DPA turnaround: legal needs a formal response to the redlines within 5 business days of your review. Please confirm that legal will meet this SLA (we've seen longer in prior vendors).

3) SIG/CAIQ gaps: thanks for the target Apr 18 for the remaining rows — can you call out which specific CAIQ sections remain (KMS, Subprocessors, Data Flow diagrams) so our security team can prioritize review?

If we can get the SOC2 excerpt + billing runbook + DPA response within the next week, procurement will schedule signatures and aim for an execution window in the week of Apr 25.

-Emma
CISO, FinWaves

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Emma Laurent <emma.laurent@finwaves.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-15T16:03:00Z
Subject: Final MAP timeline & gate checklist (FinWaves)

Emma — putting the final MAP milestones and gate acceptance criteria here so we have a single source of truth. I updated the spreadsheet and set assignees on each line item.

Final MAP milestones (target dates):
- Apr 15: SOC2 excerpt delivered (Irene) [Delivered]
- Apr 18: SIG/CAIQ completed (Irene) [ETA Apr 18]
- Apr 18: Billing retention runbook delivered (Priyom)
- Apr 19: DPA annotated response returned (Legal / Kimberly)
- Apr 25: Procurement signature window opens
- Apr 28: Target close / activation (if all gates satisfied)

Gate acceptance checklist (must be met to move to procurement signature):
- Evidence: SOC2 excerpt + control table covering encryption and access control
- SIG/CAIQ: all critical data-flow and KMS rows marked addressed or with planned mitigations and ETA
- DPA: executed with retention tiers (30/90/540 where applicable) and billing carveout noted in Exhibit A
- Ops runbook: billing data segregation and recovery procedures delivered and accepted by FinWaves

Notes and risks: If FinWaves requests physical single-tenant storage for EU traffic we will need to move to Redwood Dedicated — that change will add ~6–8 weeks. The current MAP assumes logical per-account routing and documented runbook.

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1245789), Docusign (https://www.docusign.com/DocuSign/link/FFW-2028-DPA)

Kimberly Park
Head of Legal Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: FinWaves_MAP_v3.xlsx (updated), SOC2-excerpt.pdf
